mapper.sql: E.PERSON_ID, E.EMPID, E.LOCAL_NAME, E.DEPTNO, GET_DEPT_NAME(E.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(E.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_GRADE_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(E.EMP_OFFICE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS EMP_OFFICE_NAME

HEI.SEQ, HEI.PERSON_ID, HEI.TRANS_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HEI.TRANS_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRANS_CODE_NAME, HEI.TRANS_RESOURCE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HEI.TRANS_RESOURCE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRANS_RESOURCE_NAME, HEI.START_DATE, HEI.DEPTNO, GET_DEPT_NAME(HEI.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME, HEI.EMP_TYPE_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HEI.EMP_TYPE_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS EMP_TYPE_NAME, HEI.EMP_OFFICE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HEI.EMP_OFFICE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS EMP_OFFICE_NAME, HEI.POST_GRADE_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HEI.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_GRADE_NAME, HEI.POST_FAMILY, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HEI.POST_FAMILY, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_FAMILY_NAME, HEI.REMARK, HEI.POSITION, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HEI.POSITION, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POSITION_NAME, HEI.POSITION_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HEI.POSITION_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POSITION_NO_NAME, HEI.MAIN_BUSINESS, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HEI.MAIN_BUSINESS, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS MAIN_BUSINESS_NAME, HEI.COST_CENTER, GET_DEPT_NAME(HEI.COST_CENTER, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS COST_CENTER_NAME, HEI.PAY_STEP_NO, TO_CHAR(H.DATE_LEFT, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATE_LEFT, HEI.ACTIVITY, CASE WHEN HEI.ACTIVITY = '1' THEN 'Có hiệu lực' ELSE 'Chưa hiệu lực' END AS ACTIVITY_NAME, TO_CHAR(HEI.UPDATE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS UPDATE_DATE, GET_UPDATED_INFO(HEI.UPDATED_BY) || ' ' || HEI.UPDATED_IP AS UPDATED_BY
mapper.select: SELECT FROM HR_EXPERIENCE_INSIDE HEI JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE H ON H.PERSON_ID = HEI.PERSON_ID WHERE HEI.PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND HEI.ACTIVITY IN ('1', '0') ORDER BY TO_DATE(HEI.START_DATE, 'DD.MM.YYYY') DESC, HEI.CREATE_DATE DESC
SELECT FROM HR_EXPERIENCE_INSIDE HEI JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE H ON H.PERSON_ID = HEI.PERSON_ID WHERE HEI.SEQ = #{seq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}

SELECT H.PERSON_ID, H.DEPTNO, GET_DEPT_NAME(H.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME, H.EMP_TYPE_CODE, H.POST_FAMILY, H.POST_GRADE_NO, H.POSITION, H.POSITION_NO, H.MAIN_BUSINESS, H.COST_CENTER, TO_CHAR(H.DATE_LEFT, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATE_LEFT FROM HR_EMPLOYEE H WHERE H.PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HR_EXPERIENCE_INSIDE ( SEQ, TRANS_CODE, TRANS_RESOURCE, PERSON_ID, START_DATE, DEPTNO, EMP_TYPE_CODE, EMP_OFFICE, POST_GRADE_NO, POST_FAMILY, POSITION, POSITION_NO, MAIN_BUSINESS, COST_CENTER, PAY_STEP_NO, REMARK, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATED_BY, CREATED_IP, UPDATED_IP ) VALUES ( #{seq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{transCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{transResource, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deptno, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{empTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{empOffice, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{postGradeNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{postFamily, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{position, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{positionNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mainBusiness, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{costCenter, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{payStepNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE HR_EXPERIENCE_INSIDE SET TRANS_CODE = #{transCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, START_DATE = #{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRANS_RESOURCE = #{transResource, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DEPTNO = #{deptno, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EMP_TYPE_CODE = #{empTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EMP_OFFICE = #{empOffice, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, POST_GRADE_NO = #{postGradeNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, POST_FAMILY = #{postFamily, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, POSITION = #{position, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, POSITION_NO = #{positionNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MAIN_BUSINESS = #{mainBusiness, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COST_CENTER = #{costCenter, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PAY_STEP_NO = #{payStepNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, REMARK = #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ACTIVITY = 0, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_IP = #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE SEQ = #{seq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}

UPDATE HR_EXPERIENCE_INSIDE H SET H.ACTIVITY = '2' WHERE H.PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND H.ACTIVITY = '0' AND H.SEQ IN (SELECT A.SEQ FROM HR_EXPERIENCE_INSIDE A WHERE A.PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.TRANS_CODE = '400422' AND TO_DATE(A.START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') > (SELECT MIN(TO_DATE(B.START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY')) FROM HR_EXPERIENCE_INSIDE B WHERE B.PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND B.EMP_OFFICE = '15120'))

UPDATE HR_EXPERIENCE_INSIDE SET ACTIVITY = '0' WHERE TO_DATE(START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') >= TO_DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AND PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ACTIVITY = '1'
